title: Warmly Glazed Uruguayan Beef Bowl
description: A tangy and velvety Uruguayan dish featuring genmaicha, perfect for a date night, made with ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients and served in a dolsot stone bowl.
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the sliced beef and cook until browned, about 3 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the sesame oil, apple cider vinegar, date syrup, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the glaze to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Add the brewed genmaicha tea to the glaze and stir to combine.
Return the beef to the skillet and toss to coat with the glaze.
Transfer the beef and glaze to a dolsot stone bowl and serve immediately.
